description: An invalid restoration stops a resumed condition before later operands run (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%rule text $x:X %conditions $x.parse(q).tags = ∅
%rule q $y:r %conditions $.parse(no) ∨ $y.without-elision.parse(rival) ∨ $.parse(q)
%rule r (r [+U]) :: Recursive | X :: ∅
%rule rival X
%rule no Z
